name: Zaynab Fawwaz
shortBio: Lebanese-Egyptian historian, philosopher of women’s intellect, and Nahda essayist whose biographical encyclopedia Al-Durr al-Manthur recovered 456 global women thinkers to refute biological essentialism.
centralQuestion: What does the historical archive of women scholars, poets, and rulers across East and West prove about the universality of rational capacity?

keyWorks.title: Al-Durr al-Manthur fi Tabaqat Rabbat al-Khudur (Scattered Pearls)
keyWorks.description: Monumental feminist counter-historiography cataloging 456 accomplished Arab, Islamic, and European women intellectuals.

keyWorks.title: Al-Rasa'il al-Zaynabiyya (The Zaynab Epistles)
keyWorks.description: Collected social-philosophical essays arguing for women’s equal rights to education, work, and public deliberation.
